name: Exterior Porch Floor Prime Coat
intent: Substrate + QT gated primer. Concrete primer (QT3/QT4), polyurea mfr primer (QT5), wood primer (QT3/QT4). QT2 skips prime (acrylic sealer self-priming on concrete, no prime on wood).
doctrine: Porch floor prime. QT2 skips prime entirely (acrylic sealer self-priming on concrete, wood QT2 no prime). QT3/QT4 concrete = standard concrete primer. QT5 concrete = polyurea manufacturer-specific primer. QT3/QT4 wood = exterior wood primer. Spray+backroll is 2-crew on concrete.
